subject.title: Dashboard: widget write-back — persist widget state via a setState bridge capability

question: Should dashboard widget write-back become a bundled OpenClaw plugin capability once the dashboard foundation is accepted, or should this stacked feature pause until that product direction is sponsored?
rationale: The PR introduces a persistent plugin API and security-sensitive sandbox write capability on top of an unmerged contributor-led dashboard foundation; code repair alone cannot establish that permanent product boundary.

options.title: Pause pending foundation
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer repair and landing until the dashboard foundation has explicit maintainer sponsorship and a viable merge path.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded repair
options.body: Approve the capability direction, then require migration to the existing SQLite plugin-state facade, end-to-end version forwarding, focused proof, and a clean rebased delta.

recommendation.title: Pause pending foundation
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but defer repair and landing until the dashboard foundation has explicit maintainer sponsorship and a viable merge path.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this person most directly to the canonical plugin-state storage boundary, filesystem safety, and recent adoption of that store for plugin-owned state.
